tool.name: pRESTO ClusterSets
tool.command: ln -s '$fastq_in' in.fastq && ClusterSets.py '$cc.command' --nproc "\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" --cluster=vsearch -s in.fastq #if $cc.command == "barcode" and $cc.field != "" -f $cc.field #end if #if $cc.command == "set" and $cc.field != "" -f $cc.field #end if #if $cc.command == "set" and $cc.start != "" --start $cc.start #end if #if $cc.command == "set" and $cc.end != "" --end $cc.end #end if #if $delimiter !="" --delim $delimiter #end if --outdir=. --outname=tmp_cluster #if $capture_log --log '$log_out' #end if

param.name: delimiter
param.label: Delimiter
param.help: A list of the three delimiters that separate annotation blocks, field names and values, and values within a field, respectively.

param.name: command
param.label: Command
param.option: all: cluster all sequences regardless of annotation.
barcode: cluster reads by clustering barcode sequences.
set: Cluster sequences within annotation sets.

param.name: field
param.label: Barcode Field
param.help: The annotation field containing barcode sequences.

param.name: field
param.label: Annotation Field
param.help: The annotation field containing annotations, such as UMI barcode, for sequence grouping.

param.name: start
param.label: Sequence start
param.help: The start of the region to be used for clustering. Together with –end, this parameter can be used to specify a subsequence of each read to use in the clustering algorithm.

param.name: end
param.label: Sequence end
param.help: The end of the region to be used for clustering.
